messages:
Ajay: quick check — where do I find the current kv/prefix cache hit-rate panels? getting noise from an alert and want to eyeball baseline before I tweak thresholds.
Maria: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/kv-platform/prefix-kv-overview (panel: 'prefetch hit rate / prefix')
Maria: if you don't see it, open the left nav -> 'Platform' -> 'Caches' -> 'Prefix KV'
Ajay: thanks! any idea who owns the alert `kv_prefix_hitrate_alert`? it's firing ~5x/day but looks like small blips not rollouts.
Liam: paging from infra — *we* set the alert originally, but ownership transferred to eng-platform last quarter. cc @Maria for handoff.
Maria: yeah we own the alert now. it's a simple threshold on `prefix_cache_hitrate{env="prod"}`. rule lives in infra-alerts repo: `alerts/platform/prefix_kv.hcl`
Maria: current rule: `if prefix_cache_hitrate < 0.7 for 10m then fire`
Ajay: got it. when I pull traces, what span names to look for for cache misses?
Liam: look for spans `kv.prefix.lookup` then check tag `result=miss` — traces are in Tempo, quick query: `service="runtime" span_name="kv.prefix.lookup" tag.result:miss`
Maria: also check logs: `level=info component=kv cache=prefix event=miss` — Kibana saved search: https://kibana.redwood.net/s/kv-misses
Ajay: ok, I see the panel. Hitrate is ~0.72 but there are short drops to 0.55 for 3-4m windows. probably not prod impacting but noisy alert.
Nora: fwiw operations prefer we make alerts more actionable: either increase window to 15m or add a velocity condition (drop >= 10% sustained).
Liam: Agreed. Proposal: change to `if avg(prefix_cache_hitrate[15m]) < 0.65 for 10m` OR add a secondary check `requests_per_min > 100` so low-traffic blips don't fire.
Maria: I'm happy to open a PR to infra-alerts with suggested rule + brief rationale. can someone add the debugging steps to the runbook (where to check traces/logs/panel links)?
Ajay: please. tag me on the PR. I can test on staging by replaying the miss pattern (small script I have).
Maria: note: sre-bot recently added an alert suppression window for deploys, but this one skips suppression — I can add a note if desired.
sre-bot: [auto] Alert `kv_prefix_hitrate` triggered 2026-03-01T10:22:10Z for prod cluster "us-west-2". Link: https://alerts.redwood.net/alert/kv_prefix_hitrate/3271 :rotating_light:
Nora: ok plan: Maria opens PR with two options (higher window OR traffic gating). We'll review + merge, then monitor for 48h. Ajay will run repro in staging. Liam monitors post-merge for any regressions.
Ajay: perfect. one more ask — can someone add a panel for 'prefix miss rate by prefix namespace' to help triage which prefixes are noisy?
Maria: on it. I'll add the panel and link it in the PR description.
Liam: thanks all :thumbsup:
Ajay: thanks everyone, will update once staging run done.
